note: 6 personas × 8 angles. Hooks are ICP-derived hypotheses (04 §3) — replace with verbatim sales-call language when transcripts land. A8 is the product-demo angle: no hook, static format only, the screenshot carries it.

P1.name: PD Director / Coordinator
P1.pain: I have three spreadsheets and a Google Form and the state report takes a week
P1.proof: 80% less registration admin; Act 48 / SCECH / CTLE reporting on demand; since 1996, never acquired

P2.name: Registrar / Director of Student Services
P2.pain: Paper packets in a filing cabinet and a lottery someone runs in Excel
P2.proof: Families register from a phone in their language; seeded, re-runnable lottery with audit trail

P3.name: Curriculum & Instruction Director / Coaching Coordinator
P3.pain: My coaches are doing the work and I can't show it happened
P3.proof: Offline tablet logging from the classroom; planned vs. delivered by site; non-evaluative, educator data only

P4.name: CCR&R Executive Director / Program Director
P4.pain: Intake in one place, providers in another, referral history in a spreadsheet
P4.proof: One system; funder report generated from operational data; On Track by 5 / LPSS reference

P5.name: Superintendent / Executive Director
P5.pain: What happens to our data, and who do I call
P5.proof: 33+ states since 1996; FERPA and security pages; a published phone number answered by certified staff

P6.name: CourseWhere / legacy Wisdomwhere admin
P6.pain: We've been on this since 2009 and nobody knows how it works anymore
P6.proof: Documented upgrade path, data migrated by us, same company
